statements.impact_statement: Measured 2026-11-10 on Wolfi helm-4 4.3.1-r1 (/usr/bin/helm, the newest helm apk in the x86_64 APKINDEX, the only binary in this image on golang.org/x/net v0.60.0; kubectl-1.37 1.37.2-r1 links v0.62.0). `govulncheck -mode=binary /usr/bin/helm` reports 0 vulnerabilities in called code and 0 in imported packages: x/net v0.60.0 is only a required module, and helm imports no golang.org/x/net/html package, which is where both findings live (GO-2026-6860 html.Parse, GO-2026-6866 html.Render). The vulnerable code is not compiled into the binary. Re-check when Wolfi rebuilds helm-4 with x/net >= v0.62.0, and drop this statement then.
